steps.label: Internet
steps.title: Connect to the internet
steps.lead: This device needs internet for remote access and video. Cellular usually connects on its own — join Wi-Fi here if you'd rather use it.

steps.label: Remote access
steps.title: Remote access
steps.lead: Reach this device securely from anywhere, without opening ports. Connecting opens a Tailscale sign-in page — you'll need a Tailscale account, and the free tier covers a device like this. Optional, and you can do it later from Connection.

steps.label: Camera
steps.title: Camera
steps.lead: Point the device at your camera's RTSP stream. We'll give the camera's network port a fixed address, apply the source, then check video is flowing.

steps.label: Telemetry
steps.title: Telemetry
steps.lead: Telemetry starts on its own once the flight controller is plugged into one of this device's USB ports with a data cable — wiring to the Pi's pins is not picked up. Power it on and the endpoint appears below.

steps.label: Done
steps.title: Almost there
steps.lead: One item still needs attention — tap it to go back and finish, or leave it and set it up later from the Device tab.

online.text: Not online yet — waiting for cellular, or join Wi-Fi below.

internet.hint: Detailed cellular and link status lives on Connection. You can continue either way.

banner.title: Not connected
banner.subtitle: Join this device to your tailnet for secure remote access.

remote.hint: Starts a sign-in — on a cellular link this can take ~20s. A login link will then appear here to finish in your browser.

control.title: Control server — Tailscale
control.hint: Most setups need nothing here — just use Connect to Tailscale above. Enter your own Headscale server URL only if you self-host. An auth key lets it sign in unattended.

wizard.name: cam2

transports.label: Automatic — UDP for low latency, switches to TCP if it drops frames

wizard.coverage: Only RTSP ports 554 and 8554 are checked, on subnets of 254 addresses or fewer. Ports that found nothing are then asked over ARP, which reaches the subnets drone cameras ship on even when this device has no address there. A camera outside all of that needs its address typed below.

camera.hint: Ground station links, publishing and the rest of this camera's settings live on Cameras.

waiting.text: Waiting for a flight controller on USB — this is optional, you can finish without it.
